plugins.name: grow-product-manager
plugins.description: AI assistant for Product Managers — 31 skills, 3 agents, 5 commands, 12 connectors, 2 hooks across five contours, integrated with Jira, Confluence, Figma and Tableau. **Product:** research, concepts/PRDs, requirements, task creation, CJM funnel research, data analysis, brainstorming, experiment tracking and flow walkthroughs in the real product (web, desktop, iPhone app on a Mac, Android via adb) with multi-role legs on test accounts, and a product landscape registry (scan installed apps, discover competitors and adjacent products by category, map, cross-product research). **Delivery:** roadmap/quarterly/sprint planning, Jira ops reports, release automation. **Knowledge:** knowledge library, decision log, feedback triage, meeting processing (MoM, action items), multilingual artifact templates. **People:** goals, 1-1s, performance reviews, hiring, offboarding, delegation — with vault-local person profiles. **Design:** diagrams and prototypes, plus brand-themed decks and handoffs with WCAG 2.1 AA gates. Bring your own Design System, toolkit and org context — the plugin ships no hardcoded brand or organization data. **Components (v2.5.0):** declared connectors (Connectors tab), three tool-restricted agents (artifact-checker, debater, extractor) behind the quality gate, Debate Mode and fan-out reads, user-only service commands (status, config, release, glossary-lint, setup), and host hooks (v2.6.0): a SessionStart context digest and a human-in-the-loop write gate before Jira/Confluence writes. **Judgment (v3.4.0):** a ten-principle judgment contract every skill reads at Step 0j — the plugin creates freely and decides carefully. **Roles (v3.5.0):** eight role profiles (PM, Head of Product, CPO, Product Designer, Product Analyst, UX Researcher, Engineering Lead, Business Owner) change defaults, never capabilities — asked once, hats for one run, an altitude line on every product artifact. **Role defaults (v3.6.0):** the role's template ranked first (design brief, strategy / decision memo, business case, research plan, interview guide, insight report / memo, QBR, board update), extra evidence checks, roll-up or delivery planning views — a user without a role sees no change. **Judgment points (v3.7.0):** your estimate before the plugin's at scoring, readout, verdict and prioritisation points (one switchable question), a confidence-and-falsifier line on the lead recommendation or verdict at those points, decision records with owner, rejected alternatives, base rate, revisit trigger and minority report. **Evidence classes (v3.8.0):** every number and quote says how it is known (observed, measured, reported, external, simulated, assumed); synthetic users never become findings; claims the data cannot support are handed back with the human step. **Quality:** artifact quality gate with maker–checker verification — an independent checker subagent screens requirements, tasks, and concepts for ungrounded AI technical content and prose-formatted requirements before they reach you; a team glossary + writing-style profile keeps artifacts in the team's own language, and annotated screenshots (numbered markers = requirement numbers) make UI requirements visual. — v3.8.0 (released 2026-10-06)
